goal: Populate global xpubs in wallet PSBTs so external hardware signers can verify and sign multisig transactions
Eliminates workarounds where external coordinators must manually inject xpub records into Core PSBTs
agreement: Concept approval after author implemented duplicate xpub handling and key derivation tests (fametrano)
Addressed earlier objections on generic descriptor handling and MuSig xpub traversal (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because stateless hardware signers reject Core multisig PSBTs without global xpub records
Resolves signing failures on devices like BitBox02 and removes manual xpub injection in coordinators
